before.story: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Amid Trump Lobbying and SEC Probe
before.summary: Nvidia reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO following intense political intervention by President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance, sparking a historic rally that restored nearly $1 trillion in market value, inflicted a $12.2 billion loss on short sellers, and lifted Taiwan's Taiex by 8.99 percent. However, the rally faded on Tuesday as Nvidia shares dropped amid persistent investor doubts over governance and ongoing SEC, DOJ, and FBI probes into Megaspeed and alleged chip diversion to China.

after.story: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Amid Trump Lobbying and SEC Probe
after.summary: Nvidia reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO following intense political intervention by President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance, sparking a historic rally that restored nearly $1 trillion in market value, inflicted a $12.2 billion loss on short sellers, and lifted Taiwan's Taiex by 8.99 percent. However, the rally faded as Nvidia shares dropped amid persistent investor doubts, board governance backlash, shareholder lawsuits, and ongoing SEC, DOJ, and FBI probes into Megaspeed and alleged chip diversion to China.

note: Consolidating coverage of Nvidia's board governance backlash and shareholder lawsuits into the CEO reinstatement cluster.

China reserved the right to take retaliatory measures while urging dialogue, Japan protested the 15% rate, Singapore challenged the 20% levy logic, Brazil's Lula administration condemned the threats as unacceptable, the EU urged a 15% cap, and Embraer shares fell.

after.story: US Proposes New Tariffs on China and 14 Nations
after.summary: The US Trade Representative unveiled proposed Section 301 tariffs on China—including an added 20% levy bringing total duties to about 40%—and 14 other trading partners, proposing up to 25% on India (capped at 17% if a trade deal is reached), 20% on Vietnam, 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, and Thailand, up to 15% on South Korea, and 10% on Brazilian aircraft and sugar while postponing a decision on Mexico and sparing Norway. India formally rejected U.S. allegations of manufacturing overcapacity, Brazil's Lula administration condemned the levies as unacceptable, China denounced them as political manipulation, the EU urged a 15% cap, and Embraer shares fell.

note: India formally rejects U.S. manufacturing overcapacity allegations tied to proposed 17% to 25% tariffs.

before.story: Fuel Truck Explosion Kills 31 in Cairo
before.summary: A fuel tanker transporting petroleum products overturned and exploded above the Ten Tunnel on Cairo's Ring Road in Giza's Warraq district, killing at least 31 people and injuring at least 25. Emergency services dispatched 39 ambulances to the scene, where the resulting inferno consumed at least 27 vehicles, including cars and motorcycles trapped in heavy traffic.

after.story: Fuel Truck Explosion Kills 31 in Cairo
after.summary: A fuel tanker transporting petroleum products overturned and exploded above the Ten Tunnel on Cairo's Ring Road in Giza's Warraq district, killing at least 31 people, injuring at least 25, and consuming at least 27 vehicles. Emergency services dispatched 39 ambulances while prosecutors detained the truck driver and dozens of families gathered at Imbaba General Hospital for news of missing relatives.

before.story: Norse Atlantic Airways Shares Collapse Over Financial Emergency
before.summary: Shares of Norwegian low-cost transatlantic carrier Norse Atlantic Airways plunged over 70 percent after management issued a critical financial emergency warning caused by soaring jet fuel costs. The abrupt suspension of Norse Atlantic's wet-lease operations forced Pakistan International Airlines to cancel two UK flights and deploy its own Boeing 777 fleet starting November 26.

after.story: Norse Atlantic Airways Shares Collapse Over Financial Emergency
after.summary: Norwegian low-cost transatlantic carrier Norse Atlantic Airways suspended all flights and warned it may file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure immediate short-term funding after its shares plunged over 70% amid soaring jet fuel costs and a European cold snap. The abrupt suspension of its wet-lease operations also forced Pakistan International Airlines to cancel two UK flights and deploy its own Boeing 777 fleet starting November 26.

note: Carrier suspends all flights and warns of bankruptcy if immediate funding is not secured

On the East Coast, 70 mph winds caused over 400 flight cancellations and knocked out power to nearly 200,000 customers in Virginia and 177,000 in Maryland.

after.story: Dual Storms Threaten US Thanksgiving Travel

On the East Coast, 70 mph winds caused over 400 flight cancellations and knocked out power to nearly 200,000 customers in Virginia and 177,000 in Maryland, while a king tide swept a man and his dog into the sea at Cannon Beach, Oregon.

before.story: EU Leaders Wrestle Over Ukraine Aid
before.summary: At an extraordinary Brussels summit, European Union leaders delayed a decision on a proposed €45 billion ($49 billion) loan for Ukraine until December after Hungary, Slovakia, and the Czech Republic demanded opt-outs, drawing sharp criticism from Ukraine's backers over their refusal to contribute despite benefiting from EU funds. While leaders agreed on Pablo Hernández de Cos at the ECB, France and Germany pushed for a year-end deal to 'Le Pen-proof' the 2028–2034 budget—with French President Emmanuel Macron warning that ending Ukraine support would put Europe's security at risk and Paris requesting an extra €35 billion for farmers.

after.story: EU Budget Summit Collapses Over Ukraine Aid and Spending
after.summary: European Union leaders cut an extraordinary Brussels summit short after more than 12 hours of tense negotiations collapsed without an agreement on the 2028–2034 budget or a proposed €45 billion ($49 billion) loan for Ukraine. While leaders agreed on Pablo Hernández de Cos at the ECB, talks broke down over Hungary, Slovakia, and the Czech Republic demanding opt-outs from Ukraine aid and sharp divisions between France and Germany over farm spending and long-term priorities.

before.story: Meta Launches Muse AI Agent in the UK
before.summary: Meta deployed its Muse artificial intelligence agent in the United Kingdom, designed to handle consumer tasks like travel booking and holiday shopping across its apps and e-commerce platforms. The launch was marked by user-reported software glitches and growing technical blockades erected by major retailers, including Amazon, aimed at stopping third-party AI shopping bots.

before.story: Canary Islands Migrant Surge Turns Deadly Off El Hierro
before.summary: Following a record-breaking surge of 3,700 arrivals in 48 hours and more than 11,000 migrants in the first two weeks of November, authorities on El Hierro declared a state of emergency and demanded federal intervention from Madrid. After the Canary Islands recorded a new single-day record of 1,990 arrivals aboard 15 boats, at least eight migrants were found dead and six were airlifted to hospital in serious condition during a maritime rescue off El Hierro.

after.story: Canary Islands Migrant Surge Turns Deadly Off El Hierro
after.summary: Following a record-breaking surge of 3,700 arrivals in 48 hours and more than 11,000 migrants in the first two weeks of November, authorities on El Hierro declared a state of emergency and demanded federal intervention from Madrid. After the Canary Islands recorded a new single-day record of 1,990 arrivals aboard 15 boats and over 2,100 arrivals in two days, 14 migrants were found dead on an adrift boat off El Hierro and six were airlifted to hospital in serious condition.

before.story: Cannes Mayor David Lisnard Re-Elected French Mayors Chief
before.summary: Cannes Mayor David Lisnard secured re-election as president of the Association of Mayors of France (AMF), reinforcing his national political springboard. Championing his libertarian-conservative movement Nouvelle Énergie, Lisnard has climbed to third place in several opinion polls ahead of the 2027 French presidential election.

before.story: IDF Kills Terrorists Working at MSF Clinic in Gaza
before.summary: An Israeli airstrike directly hit a Doctors Without Borders (MSF) clinic near Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, killing two staff watchmen. The IDF stated the operation targeted Hamas operatives, identifying slain guard Moaz Yousef Alitsbach as an artillery cell commander, drawing intense outrage from MSF and the World Health Organization.

after.story: IDF Kills Terrorists Working at MSF Clinic in Gaza
after.summary: An Israeli airstrike directly hit a Doctors Without Borders (MSF) clinic near Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, killing two staff watchmen and bringing MSF's total staff death toll since the start of the war to 17. The IDF stated the operation targeted Hamas operatives, identifying slain guard Moaz Yousef Alitsbach as an artillery cell commander, drawing intense outrage from MSF and the World Health Organization.
